fairness_audit.was_unfair: Required both paper.tex AND paper.pdf; any tool missing one failed equally.
fairness_audit.fix: Paper gate: PDF=1.0; TeX-only=0.5; ``complete`` requires PDF.
``results`` requires substantive numeric results via results_normalize.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: Penalized tools with no bib; airesearcher has no workspace references.
fairness_audit.fix: literature_applicable=false → status not_applicable; excluded from fair aggregate.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: related_work.json subset as gold made recall hard to interpret.
fairness_audit.fix: Coverage gold is original paper REFERENCES from mineru; related_work only enriches metadata/fallback.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: Missing Stanford report looked like evaluation failure.
fairness_audit.fix: status not_provided; optional axis, never counts as tool failure.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: Picked downloads/** and sandbox noise (e.g. airesearcher LLVM tree).
fairness_audit.fix: Exclude downloads/, seeds/, dataset_candidate/, sandbox junk paths.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: DeepScientist .deepscientist_npm / runtime / skills templates counted as code/paper/results.
fairness_audit.fix: FRAMEWORK_NOISE_DIRS+markers; quest worktree + eval_output results; paper md drafts; reject template tex.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: tiny_scientist / ACL runs store paper under latex/*.tex; evaluator only looked at paper/main.tex.
fairness_audit.fix: latex/**/*.tex with substantive-body heuristic; find_paper_document uses same rules.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: Entire custom.bib (300+ anthology entries) verified when paper had zero \cite commands.
fairness_audit.fix: collect_agent_references filters bib to in-text cite keys; skips uncited bulk bib (>40 entries).

fairness_audit.was_unfair: AI Scientist can persist substantive results and paper-like drafts in *_summary.json logs rather than paper/main.tex or results/**/*.json.
fairness_audit.fix: Treat draft_summary/research_summary as weak paper documents and summary JSONs as result candidates.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: Manifest framework ``ai_scientist_v2`` fell through to profile ``unknown``, skipping AI-Scientist idea/result path priorities.
fairness_audit.fix: Normalize ``ai_scientist_v2`` (and common aliases) to profile key ``ai_scientist``.

fairness_audit.was_unfair: plan.md/todos.md weak proxies scored same as structured idea.json.
fairness_audit.fix: Framework idea_priority tried first; missing idea → not_applicable where appropriate.

fairness.results_gate_rule: substantive numeric results via framework-aware normalize_results

notes: Required: idea, code, substantive results, paper (PDF full; TeX/markdown/JSON draft half).
Stub/seed metrics (e.g. dataset_candidate/metrics.json) do not satisfy results.
Framework noise (.deepscientist_npm, skills/templates, runtime) is excluded from code/results/paper.
Manifest status is informational; disk presence is authoritative.
Scores the intermediate idea artifact (not the final paper).
Dimensions: novelty, feasibility, clarity (each 1-5). Excitement removed.
Novelty is scored against a Solution Space built from mineru REFERENCES titles (+ related_work.json abstracts when matched).
Stanford Agentic Reviewer (paperreview.ai): manual download to artifacts/peer_review/stanford_apr.md, or pass --auto-paperreview.
Dimensions: soundness, significance, novelty, presentation, credibility (each 1-5).
peer_review.hint: Optional external review (Stanford APR). Upload paper/main.pdf to https://paperreview.ai/ , save review to ~/ai_scientist_inputs/ASE-2025-004_predicting_recheck_success_in_continuous/workspace/researchclaw_2026-06-21_08-36-23/artifacts/peer_review/stanford_apr.md

original.paper_title: Rechecking Recheck Requests in Continuous Integration: An Empirical Study of OpenStack

selection.note: mineru key is unreliable; blocks are selected by title/body/inheritance. rescued_from_other counts sections labeled other but treated as typed roles.

claims.statement: A statistical model trained on OpenStack recheck requests can discriminate between successful and failed rechecks well, outperforming baseline approaches by 23.6 percentage points in AUROC (0.736).
claims.evidence_quote: our model can differentiate successful and failed rechecks well, outperforming baseline approaches by 23.6 percentage points in terms of AUROC (0.736)

claims.statement: Skipping rechecks predicted to fail would avoid 86.49% of wasted rechecks and save roughly 262 years of compute time.
claims.evidence_quote: Applying our model to skip recheck requests when they are predicted to fail would avoid 86.49% of wasted rechecks, saving roughly 262 years of compute time.

experiment_success.note: success=true requires substantive results (framework-aware path) with >=3 numeric leaves. Supports metrics.json, results.json, experiment_results.txt, etc. Manifest returncode/benchmark_complete are soft warnings only.
